The company is capitalizing on growing demand for electric grid infrastructure and data center expansion, with margin expansion evident in gas power shipments at higher prices.

items.title: Boston Scientific: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Boston Scientific reported that an eight-day cyber incident and product line headwinds will flatten sales and earnings growth through 2027. The company is implementing a $500 million cost-cutting restructuring program while advancing new product pipelines targeting $25 billion in market opportunities by 2030. Management expects stabilization in 2027 and reaccelerated growth beginning in 2028.

items.title: Why Vertiv Stock Soared Today
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings stock surged 16.48% after reporting strong Q3 2026 earnings driven by AI data center demand. The company's net sales jumped 61% year-over-year to $4.3 billion, with adjusted earnings per share reaching $2.21, significantly exceeding Wall Street expectations of $1.82. Management raised full-year guidance to $7.15 per share adjusted earnings, citing accelerating infrastructure buildout for AI applications.

items.title: Monster Beverage vs. On Holding: Which Is the Better Growth Stock?
items.summary: The article compares Monster Beverage and On Holding as growth stock investments. Monster Beverage leads with $8.3B in FY2025 revenue (10.7% growth) and a 23% net margin, benefiting from strong Coca-Cola distribution and daily consumer purchases. On Holding shows aggressive growth at $3.6B revenue (30% increase) but faces lower profitability due to heavy marketing reinvestment. The author recommends Monster Beverage as the better long-term investment, citing its more stable business model, easier customer retention, and superior 2026 performance (+17.8% vs. On Holding's -30.5%).

items.title: Oracle vs. Palo Alto Networks: Which Tech Stock Is the Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: The article compares Oracle and Palo Alto Networks as enterprise tech investments for 2026. Oracle, with 22% revenue growth and strong cloud infrastructure demand, trades at a forward P/E of 15x with expected 23% earnings growth. Palo Alto Networks shows 25% revenue growth but trades at a steep 94x forward P/E multiple. The author recommends Oracle due to superior earnings growth potential, massive contracted revenue backlog ($664B), and more attractive valuation, despite risks from AI demand fluctuations and high leverage.

items.title: Raymond James Financial (RJF) Q4 Earnings: How Key Metrics Compare to Wall Street Estimates
items.summary: Raymond James Financial reported Q4 2026 revenue of $4.27 billion, up 14.5% year-over-year, beating the consensus estimate of $4.19 billion by 1.99%. EPS came in at $3.59, exceeding the consensus estimate of $3.28 by 9.45%. Key metrics showed mixed results, with strong performance in investment banking revenues (+17.1% YoY) and asset management fees (+22.9% YoY), though net interest margin came in slightly below expectations. The stock has a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

items.title: BULL INVESTOR DEADLINE: Webull Corporation Investors with Substantial Losses May Seek to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit, RGRD Law Announces - December 7, 2026 Deadline
items.summary: Webull Corporation faces a securities class action lawsuit alleging the company made false statements about its operations, claiming it misrepresented its independence from China. A U.S. House Select Committee found that Webull's ownership, workforce, and infrastructure are structurally tied to China, contradicting the company's claims of being primarily U.S.-based. The stock fell 19% following the October 2026 disclosure. Investors with substantial losses can seek lead plaintiff status by December 7, 2026.

items.title: 2 Millionaire-Maker Custom Silicon Stocks Powering the AI Infrastructure Supercycle
items.summary: Broadcom and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (TSMC) are highlighted as two leading players in custom silicon for AI infrastructure. Broadcom designs ASICs for major tech companies like Alphabet, Meta, and OpenAI, with Q3 AI semiconductor revenue up 221% year-over-year. TSMC manufactures high-end chips and controls over 90% of the advanced AI chip market. Both stocks have delivered exceptional long-term returns, though they face recent valuation volatility amid AI industry concerns.

items.title: Amrize Ltd (AMRZ) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: Amrize Ltd reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3.77 billion, up 2.6% year-over-year but missing the consensus estimate of $3.85 billion by 1.99%. EPS of $1.02 beat expectations of $0.98 by 4.08%. The company's Building Materials segment underperformed estimates while Building Envelope slightly missed. Despite a 6.7% monthly stock gain, Amrize received a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell) rating.

items.title: Not Space. Not Starlink. Here's My Top Reason to Buy SpaceX Stock.
items.summary: SpaceX's Super Intelligence (SI) division, which houses its AI data center platform and Grok language models, is emerging as the company's primary growth driver rather than its space launch or Starlink services. SI achieved $7.56 billion in Q3 2026 revenue (830% year-over-year growth) and posted $431 million in operating profit, with the company investing $16.4 billion in capital expenditures for this segment, signaling strong confidence in its AI future.

items.title: HIMS 5-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Hims & Hers Health Investors with Significant Losses Encouraged to Contact Hagens Berman Before Nov. 2, 2026 Deadline in Securities Class Action
items.summary: Hims & Hers Health faces a securities class action lawsuit following an FTC complaint alleging deceptive health data sharing with third-party advertising platforms and ROSCA violations related to subscription billing practices. The company's stock plunged 14.7% on July 29, 2026, erasing over $970 million in market value. Investors with substantial losses are urged to submit claims before the November 2, 2026 deadline.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 28: SK Hynix Surges on Record Q3 Results and AI-Memory Demand
items.summary: SK Hynix surged 13.30% on October 28, 2026, following record Q3 results with a sevenfold jump in operating profit and an 80% operating margin. The memory chipmaker's strong performance was driven by robust AI-memory demand, with DRAM and HBM production effectively sold out through 2029. Peers Micron Technology and SanDisk also rallied on the positive sentiment around AI-memory demand.

items.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Reports Q3 Earnings: What Key Metrics Have to Say
items.summary: ServiceNow reported Q3 2026 revenue of $4.11 billion, up 20.5% year-over-year and beating consensus estimates by 0.46%. However, EPS of $1.00 missed expectations of $1.02 by 1.96%. The company showed strong subscription revenue growth of 20.9% and exceeded guidance on remaining performance obligations. Despite solid operational metrics, the stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: Global Battery Warranty Analytics Market Report 2026: Size, Trends and Forecast to 2030 | Capitalize on AI-Led 15.3% CAGR With Siemens, IBM, SAP, TWAICE and ACCURE
items.summary: The global battery warranty analytics market is projected to grow from $0.99 billion in 2025 to $2.01 billion by 2030, with a CAGR of 15.3%. Growth is driven by expanding EV adoption, AI-based predictive analytics, cloud-based monitoring solutions, and digital twin technologies. Key players include Siemens, IBM, SAP, TWAICE, and ACCURE, with innovations like ACCURE's Warranty Tracker improving warranty compliance and cost control in energy storage operations.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Oct. 28: Boston Scientific Slips 6% After Cutting Q4 Sales and Full-Year EPS Guidance on Cyberattack Impact
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) stock fell 6% after the medical device maker cut its Q4 sales and full-year EPS guidance due to ongoing disruptions from an August cyberattack. The company estimated the eight-day cyberattack cost it 300 basis points in sales growth and $0.07 in adjusted EPS. Management expects a slow recovery with 2027 projected as the trough year, though the stock now trades at a relatively low 13x forward earnings multiple.

items.title: 2 AI Stocks to Buy if the Market Sells Off Before Year-End
items.summary: The article discusses SpaceX and Tesla as potential AI stock buys during a market downturn. While both companies show strong AI-driven growth prospects—SpaceX's Super Intelligence segment grew 830% YoY and Tesla's Full Self-Driving software generates ~$1B in recurring revenue—the author recommends waiting for better entry points, as both stocks are currently overvalued with forward P/E ratios of 85.5 and 133.3 respectively.

items.title: Home Depot vs. Target: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: The article compares Home Depot and Target as retail investment options for 2026. While Home Depot demonstrates stronger financials with $164.7B revenue and 8.6% net margin, Target is recommended as the better buy due to its lower valuation (P/E 14.6x vs 21.3x), new CEO Michael Fiddelke's $5B transformation initiative showing strong early results (6% sales growth, 35% profit increase in H1 2026), and higher dividend yield of 3.1%. Both stocks face distinct risks including macroeconomic headwinds for Home Depot and operational challenges for Target.

items.title: Deadline Alert: Bank Of America Corporation Investors Have Until December 15, 2026 to Seek Lead Plaintiff Role in Securities Fraud Class Action, Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP Reminds Investors
items.summary: Bank of America faces a securities fraud class action lawsuit covering investors who purchased securities between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges the company failed to disclose systemic weaknesses in its Bank Secrecy Act/anti-money laundering compliance program that caused it to improperly monitor trillions in transactions. The allegations follow a $1.2 billion fine from the U.S. Department of the Treasury announced on October 13, 2026, which caused the stock to fall 4.76%. Investors have until December 15, 2026 to seek lead plaintiff status.

items.title: Kaplan Fox Reminds Duolingo, Inc. (NASDAQ: DUOL) Investors of a Securities Class Action Deadline on December 7, 2026
items.summary: Kaplan Fox has filed a securities class action lawsuit against Duolingo on behalf of investors who purchased stock between May 2, 2025 and February 26, 2026. The complaint alleges that Duolingo made false and misleading statements about the negative impact of increased ad volume, subscription upsells, and AI-generated content on daily active user growth. The company's stock dropped significantly following disappointing financial results and the CFO's departure, with declines of 25%, 8.5%, and 14% on three separate dates.

items.title: Kaplan Fox & Kilsheimer LLP Alerts Bank of America Corporation (NYSE: BAC) Investors to a Securities Class Action Deadline on December 15, 2026
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America on behalf of investors who purchased stock between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026. The lawsuit follows the U.S. Department of the Treasury's announcement of over $1.2 billion in penalties and settlements against Bank of America's subsidiary for violations of Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering laws, including failure to detect and report over $5 billion in suspicious activity. The regulatory settlement reduced the company's Q3 2026 diluted earnings per share by $0.17, and the stock fell 4.8% following the disclosure.

items.title: SPGI Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Strategic Review and Growth Outlook
items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) raised its full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $17.70-$17.95 and organic revenue growth to 7.5%-8.5%, driven by strong performance in Ratings and Indices segments. The company announced a strategic review of its Capital IQ and related data businesses with potential separation, expecting clarity by February 2027. AI adoption accelerated with API call volumes rising nearly 50%, while the company plans over $7 billion in share repurchases for 2026.

items.title: Amphenol's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: Amphenol (APH) delivered exceptional Q3 2026 results with adjusted earnings up 73.9% to 80 cents per share and revenues surging 65.1% to $10.23 billion, driven by strong IT datacom demand and acquisitions. The company raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $36.9-$37.1 billion, increased its quarterly dividend by 20%, and authorized a new $4 billion share repurchase program. Operating margins expanded 220 basis points to 29.7%, while the company completed the Empire Electronics acquisition and signed agreements for three additional acquisitions totaling $1.6 billion.

items.title: Teradyne Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Year over Year
items.summary: Teradyne (TER) reported Q3 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $2.29 per share, up 169.4% YoY and beating consensus by 12.26%. Revenues surged 69.8% YoY to $1.306 billion, driven by record Memory and Integrated Systems Test revenues fueled by AI-related demand. The Semiconductor Test segment generated 82.1% of revenues. Operating margins expanded significantly to 31.6% from 20.4%, and the company raised its cash position to $460.7 million. Q4 2026 guidance projects revenues of $1.25-1.35 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.95-2.25.

items.title: CoStar Group Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: CoStar Group (CSGP) reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of 38 cents per share, up 65.2% year-over-year, beating consensus estimates. Revenues rose 14.1% to $952 million, marking the 62nd consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth. The company achieved significant profitability improvements with adjusted EBITDA doubling to $229 million and margins expanding 1,000 basis points to 24%. However, net new bookings declined to $84 million from $135 million due to weaker residential demand. CoStar raised its 2026 guidance and reaffirmed its $1.25 billion adjusted EBITDA target by 2028.

items.title: PepsiCo Hasn't Been This Cheap Relative to Earnings in 6 Years. Here's Why That's the Signal to Buy.
items.summary: PepsiCo's stock has fallen 20% since early 2024 and is trading at just 17x earnings, its lowest valuation in 6 years, due to struggles in its North American business where pricing increases have backfired and volume growth has stalled. Despite these challenges, the company's strong dividend yield of 4.3%, solid balance sheet, and activist investor involvement suggest the stock offers compelling value for long-term investors.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Bank of America Corporation (NYSE: BAC) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Bank of America Corporation alleging the bank made false and misleading statements regarding its Bank Secrecy Act and Anti-Money Laundering compliance program. The lawsuit claims BAC failed to properly monitor trillions of dollars in transactions and failed to adequately remediate compliance deficiencies documented in internal reports following a 2024 Consent Order. Investors who purchased BAC securities between August 1, 2025 and October 13, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of December 15, 2026.

items.title: BigBear.ai: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: BigBear.ai raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $150-165 million following strong Q3 performance with 31% year-over-year revenue growth. The company expanded its customer base across multiple government agencies including the FBI, Coast Guard, and NASA, while maintaining a capital-efficient business model focused on custom AI software applications rather than infrastructure buildout. The company expects to enter 2027 debt-free with a $330 million contract backlog.

items.title: Fabrinet Drops 19% in a Month: Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock at the Dip?
items.summary: Fabrinet (FN) shares have fallen 19% in the past month due to concerns over customer concentration, slowing NVIDIA-related revenues, margin pressure, and negative free cash flow. The stock trades at a stretched P/CF multiple of 48.61. However, strong AI infrastructure demand, expanding DCI opportunities, and new hyperscale customer wins provide growth potential. Zacks rates FN as a Hold, suggesting investors wait for a more favorable entry point.

items.title: NiSource Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Columbia Gains, Revenues Miss
items.summary: NiSource reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of 27 cents per share, beating estimates by 22.73%, with a 42.1% year-over-year increase. The company raised its long-term earnings growth outlook to 10-11% through 2033 and expanded its capital investment plan to $40 billion, driven by data center partnerships with Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet. However, revenues missed estimates and NIPSCO faced higher operating costs.

items.title: BIIB's Q3 Earnings Beat, New Drugs Aid Sales, '26 EPS View Tightened
items.summary: Biogen beat Q3 2026 earnings and revenue estimates with adjusted EPS of $2.62 and revenues of $2.80 billion. Growth drugs Skyclarys, Qalsody, Zurzuvae, and acquired Apellis products drove strong performance, with growth portfolio revenues rising ~50% year-over-year. However, legacy MS portfolio declined 13% and biosimilar sales fell 19%. The company tightened 2026 EPS guidance to $15.95-$16.75 while maintaining mid-single-digit revenue growth expectations.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Bronstein Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Announces Class Action Against Honeywell Aerospace, Inc. (NASDAQ: HONA) — Investors Who Suffered Losses Are Encouraged to Contact the Firm.
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA) alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made materially false statements and failed to disclose that key suppliers had disproportionate impact on sales and were experiencing supply constraints, that these issues would materially impact profitability, and that the company was under investigation for false Claims Act violations related to cybersecurity requirements on government contracts. Investors who purchased securities between June 29, 2026 and September 1, 2026 may be eligible to recover losses, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 23, 2026.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements regarding its capital requirements, liquidity position, competitive standing in the satellite direct-to-cell market, and user adoption rates in the US and Japan during the period from March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026.

items.title: Prediction: Palantir Stock Will Skyrocket After Nov. 2
items.summary: Palantir Technologies is expected to beat Wall Street expectations when it reports Q3 earnings on Nov. 2. The AI software company has consistently exceeded earnings estimates over the past four quarters, driven by strong customer growth and expansion of its AI Platform. With improving margins, a PEG ratio under 1 indicating undervaluation, and potential for guidance to exceed consensus, the stock could see a significant boost following the earnings report.

items.title: 2 AI Stocks Down 48% to 70% to Buy Now and Hold for 10 Years
items.summary: Ciena and Astera Labs, two AI infrastructure suppliers, have experienced significant stock declines but remain well-positioned for long-term growth. Ciena, a leader in optical networking, expects its addressable market to double to $52 billion by 2029 with strong revenue growth and expanding market share. Astera Labs designs AI connectivity chips with accelerating revenue growth and high margins, positioning both companies as key beneficiaries of continued AI data center expansion.

items.title: Generac Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on C&I Strength, Revenues Miss
items.summary: Generac Holdings reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.54, beating estimates by 6.7%, with earnings up 38.8% year-over-year. While revenues missed expectations at $1.29B, the company's Commercial & Industrial segment surged 28% driven by data center demand, with backlog reaching $4.5B. A major $2.4B long-term supply agreement with Amazon for backup power generators in 2027-2028 significantly boosts growth visibility. Generac raised its 2026 EBITDA margin guidance and maintained full-year sales outlook.

items.title: BSX Q3 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y, Stock Down
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) reported Q3 2026 revenues of $5.14 billion, beating estimates by 0.68%, with EPS meeting expectations at 73 cents. However, the company cut full-year 2026 sales and earnings guidance due to cybersecurity challenges, margin compression from higher product costs, and weakness in Endoscopy, Urology, and APAC regions. The stock fell 4.6% in pre-market trading following the announcement.

items.title: PayPal's Q3 Earnings Beat, Transaction Revenues & TPV Rises Y/Y
items.summary: PayPal reported Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $1.45, beating estimates of $1.31, but revenues of $8.58 billion missed expectations. Transaction revenues rose 3% to $7.71 billion while value-added services fell 2%. TPV increased 6% to $487.14 billion and payment transactions grew 7% to 6.80 billion. The company raised its full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $5.60 from $5.38.

items.title: IP Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Sales Miss on Lower Volumes
items.summary: International Paper reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of 37 cents per share, beating estimates by 23.3%, with North America operating profit rebounding to $427 million. However, the company posted negative free cash flow of $267 million, lowered its 2026 North America EBITDA guidance, and faces persistent demand weakness in EMEA. The company continues preparing to spin off its EMEA packaging business as DS Smith plc.

items.title: SYK Q3 Earnings: Can Recovery Momentum Offset Operational Headwinds?
items.summary: Stryker (SYK) is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 29 with EPS growth of 11.6% to $3.56 and revenue growth of 8.6% to $6.58 billion, supported by strong hospital equipment demand and Mako robotic adoption. However, the stock faces headwinds from peripheral vascular supply disruptions, cybersecurity remediation costs, and margin pressures. The company carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) with a negative Earnings ESP of -1.04%, suggesting limited upside potential.

items.title: Garmin Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: Garmin exceeded Q3 2026 earnings expectations with pro forma EPS of $2.76 (beating $2.38 estimate) and 12% net sales growth to $1.99B. Fitness and Outdoor segments drove growth with 16% and 20% revenue increases respectively, supported by strong wearable and adventure watch demand. The company raised its 2026 full-year revenue guidance to $8.15B and pro forma EPS forecast to $10.80, while expanding gross and operating margins.

items.title: Ventas Q3 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Strong SHOP Growth
items.summary: Ventas (VTR) beat Q3 earnings expectations with normalized FFO of 99 cents per share (up 10% YoY) and revenues of $1.83 billion (up 23% YoY). Senior housing same-store cash NOI grew 15.5% with occupancy improving 290 bps to 92.1%. The company raised 2026 FFO guidance to $3.87-$3.90 per share, driven by $5.2 billion in year-to-date senior housing investments. Leverage improved with net debt-to-EBITDA at 4.4x.

items.title: TXN's Gross Margin Crosses 64% in Q3: Can It Improve Further?
items.summary: Texas Instruments achieved a Q3 gross margin of 64.2%, up from 57.4% year-ago, driven by higher sales volumes, factory utilization, and pricing power. Data center revenues surged 95% YoY, while the company's 300-mm wafer strategy promises 40% cost savings. However, TXN's forward P/E of 29.83 significantly exceeds the industry average of 16.66, reflecting elevated valuation expectations.

items.title: UPS or UNP: Which Transportation Stock You Should Buy Post Q3 Earnings
items.summary: Both Union Pacific (UNP) and United Parcel Service (UPS) beat Q3 2026 earnings estimates. UPS raised full-year guidance with improved revenues and EPS outlook, while UNP posted strong volume growth and pricing gains. Despite UPS's better earnings surprise history, UNP is recommended as the more attractive option due to stronger stock performance, successful cost-cutting efforts, and improving freight demand conditions.

items.title: WDC Q1 Earnings Call Highlights Pricing Strength and Storage Demand
items.summary: Western Digital (WDC) exceeded earnings expectations with Q1 non-GAAP EPS of $4.64 vs. consensus of $4.09, driven by 55% revenue growth to $4.38 billion. The company shipped 248 exabytes with average selling prices per terabyte up 28% year-over-year. Management projects Q2 revenues of $5.1 billion (69% YoY growth) and expects further pricing improvements over the next 3-4 quarters, supported by strong AI-driven demand visibility extending into 2030-2031. WDC is advancing ePMR and HAMR technology transitions to increase storage capacity without expanding manufacturing footprint.

items.title: IDEX Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on HST Strength, View Raised
items.summary: IDEX Corporation beat Q3 2026 earnings expectations with adjusted EPS of $2.33 (vs. $2.23 estimate) and sales of $951.7 million, driven by strong demand in data center power, semiconductors, and defense markets. The company raised its full-year 2026 organic sales growth guidance to 6.5-6.8% and adjusted EPS guidance to $8.91-$8.96, reflecting confidence in broadening demand across its business segments.

items.title: Innodata vs. SoundHound AI: Consistent Growth vs. Fluctuating Revenue
items.summary: Innodata demonstrates stronger and more consistent revenue growth, increasing nearly 75% over two years with steady quarterly gains, while SoundHound AI shows volatile quarter-to-quarter fluctuations despite overall upward trajectory. Innodata projects 43% fiscal 2026 revenue growth to $360 million with profitability, whereas SoundHound AI expects 49% growth to $252 million but faces wider losses and negative free cash flow.

items.title: Aptiv Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
items.summary: Aptiv is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on Nov. 3 with a projected 38.7% year-over-year earnings decline to $1.33 per share and 39.3% revenue decline to $3.16 billion, primarily due to the Versigent spin-off. While new ADAS wins and tech partnerships with NVIDIA and Kyndryl provide some support, higher commodity costs, delayed vehicle launches, and slower production ramps are pressuring profitability. The company has an Earnings ESP of +2.23% and Zacks Rank #4 (Sell), suggesting limited likelihood of an earnings beat.

items.title: Ingersoll Rand Gears Up to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Offing?
items.summary: Ingersoll Rand is expected to report Q3 2026 revenues of $2.04 billion (up 4.5%) and adjusted EPS of 89 cents (up 3.5%), driven by segment growth and acquisition synergies. However, rising expenses and foreign currency headwinds are anticipated to pressure margins, with adjusted EBITDA margin expected to decline 120 basis points year-over-year. The company's negative Earnings ESP of -0.28% suggests limited likelihood of beating consensus estimates.

items.title: Monday.com vs. Okta: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2027?
items.summary: The article compares monday.com and Okta as investment options for 2027. Monday.com, a work management platform, grew revenue 27% in 2025 but slowed to 22% in Q2 2026 and is cutting 20% of its workforce. Okta, an identity and access management provider, shows steadier growth at 12% with strong free cash flow generation of $863 million annually. Despite monday.com's lower valuation (3x sales vs. Okta's 11x), the author recommends Okta for its consistent cash generation and execution, while suggesting monday.com as a watch list candidate pending restructuring results.

items.title: SoundHound vs. C3.ai: Which AI Stock Has More Growth Potential?
items.summary: SoundHound AI (SOUN) and C3.ai (AI) are compared as emerging enterprise AI players. SoundHound offers stronger long-term growth potential with projected 62.2% revenue growth in 2027 and a lower valuation multiple (5.32X vs 8.38X), despite current losses and integration risks from its LivePerson acquisition. C3.ai shows improving earnings estimates and better recent stock performance but faces revenue contraction and ongoing turnaround uncertainty. Both stocks carry a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

items.title: Sandisk Stock Is Down 45% From Its High. History Suggests This Is What Happens Next.
items.summary: Sandisk stock has declined 45% from its June peak, but historical analysis shows the company is prone to extreme volatility with frequent sharp recoveries. As a major flash memory and storage hardware manufacturer benefiting from AI infrastructure demand, Sandisk has achieved record margins (85% gross margin in Q4 FY2026) due to supply shortages and pricing power. However, investors should expect continued volatility as the industry is cyclical and will cool once supply catches up to demand.

items.title: GLW Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Revenue Growth
items.summary: Corning Incorporated (GLW) exceeded Q3 2026 earnings and revenue expectations with core EPS up 36% to 91 cents and revenues up 19% to $5.081 billion. The Optical Communications segment surged 44% driven by AI demand, with enterprise networks growing 84%. The company reaffirmed its Springboard targets of $30 billion in annualized sales by 2028 and $40 billion by 2030, while addressing capacity constraints and expecting Q4 revenues between $5.2-5.3 billion.

items.title: FFIV Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Systems Growth
items.summary: F5 Inc. (FFIV) delivered better-than-expected Q4 fiscal 2026 results with earnings beating estimates by 4.3% and revenues rising 13% to $917 million. The company benefited from strong systems demand (up 29%), AI-related bookings exceeding $100 million, and hybrid multicloud adoption. However, operating margins contracted due to higher component costs and increased operating expenses. For fiscal 2027, F5 projects 8-9% revenue growth and EPS of $18.00-$18.30.

items.title: Nvidia & AMD Bet $4B on Meta: Grab These ETFs to Own the AI Ecosystem
items.summary: Nvidia ($3 billion) and AMD ($1 billion) have committed to investing in Meta's $95 billion equity raise to support its AI infrastructure and superintelligence ambitions. This strategic move locks in hardware customers and creates a feedback loop benefiting the entire AI ecosystem. Rather than picking individual stocks, diversified AI-focused ETFs offer investors exposure to the interconnected tech giants driving this capex supercycle.

items.title: NXPI Q3 Earnings Call Highlights SDV and Data Center Growth
items.summary: NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) reported Q3 earnings of $4.20 per share, up 35% year-over-year, and revenues of $3.79 billion, up 19% YoY, beating consensus estimates. The company highlighted software-defined vehicles (SDVs) exceeding $1.5B run rate, industrial AI adoption accelerating, and data center revenues projected to exceed $1B by 2028. Management targets double-digit revenue growth and 60% gross margin in 2027, supported by operational efficiencies and capacity investments.

items.title: Fortive Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Core Growth, View Raised
items.summary: Fortive Corporation reported Q3 adjusted EPS of 77 cents, up 13.2% YoY and beating consensus by 10%, with revenues rising 7.8% to $1.11 billion. The Intelligent Operating Solutions segment led growth with 9.1% core revenue gains, while Advanced Healthcare Solutions faced margin pressure. The company raised its 2026 EPS guidance to $3.10-$3.14 and repurchased $300 million in shares.

items.title: Can Innodata's AI Pipeline Fuel Growth Beyond Its 40% Revenue Outlook?
items.summary: Innodata reiterated its 40%+ revenue growth outlook for 2026, driven by strong Q2 results with 58% revenue growth to $92.1M and 92% EBITDA growth. The company is expanding into agentic AI and reinforcement learning with a robust pipeline, though deal conversion remains uncertain. Innodata faces competition from Palantir and TaskUs in the AI services space.

items.title: Gaming and Leisure Properties Enters Joint Venture with Prologis, Inc. to Develop the Former Hollywood Casino Joliet Site
items.summary: Gaming and Leisure Properties (GLPI) announced a joint venture with Prologis (PLD) to develop the former Hollywood Casino Joliet site into a Class A warehouse and distribution park. GLPI will contribute the 262-acre parcel while Prologis serves as managing member and developer. The project, expected to span five years in three phases, will create over 3.8 million square feet of industrial space, marking GLPI's first expansion outside the gaming sector.

items.title: Arista Networks vs. DocuSign: Which Tech Stock Is the Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: The article compares Arista Networks and DocuSign as investment options for 2026. Arista dominates AI infrastructure networking with 33% YoY revenue growth and strong margins, while DocuSign provides agreement management software with more modest 9% growth. The author recommends Arista despite higher valuations, citing accelerating demand, tripled purchase commitments, and expected 40% revenue growth versus DocuSign's single-digit growth.

items.title: Want Income for Life? This Dividend Stock Has Funded Investment Portfolios With Growing Passive Income for 57 Straight Years.
items.summary: Altria Group (MO), a tobacco company, is highlighted as a Dividend King with 57 consecutive years of dividend increases and a 6% yield. Despite declining U.S. smoking rates, the company maintains strong pricing power through brand loyalty and nicotine addiction, using price hikes to offset falling sales volumes. However, long-term risks exist as the model may eventually fail if smokers can't afford higher prices or if diversification efforts beyond Marlboro cigarettes don't succeed.

items.title: Onto Innovation's Q3 Revenue Outlook: Can Sales Hit $400M?
items.summary: Onto Innovation raised its Q3 2026 revenue guidance to $380M-$400M and increased full-year advanced packaging growth outlook to 80% from 50%, driven by strong demand for Dragonfly inspection products and advanced nodes. The company's record backlog exceeded $1.1B with 60-70% relating to 2026, supporting second-half revenue growth of at least 25% and operating margins reaching 32-33%.

items.title: Can nVent Electric Become the Next Vertiv?
items.summary: nVent Electric is positioned as a potential next-generation investment opportunity similar to Vertiv's AI data center liquid cooling success. With a smaller market cap ($21B vs Vertiv's $80B), faster revenue growth (53% vs 24%), lower valuation (19.5 P/E vs 21.8 P/E), and a $2.5B backlog, nVent offers more room for expansion in the booming AI infrastructure market while maintaining positive free cash flow growth of 125% year-over-year.

items.title: Generac Holdings (GNRC) Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Generac Holdings reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.54 per share, beating consensus estimates of $2.38, but revenues of $1.29 billion missed expectations by 1.48%. The stock has gained 42.1% year-to-date, outperforming the S&P 500's 12.8% gain. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed estimate revisions, suggesting near-term performance in line with the market. The Manufacturing - General Industrial industry ranks in the bottom 38% of Zacks industries.

items.title: INVESTIGATION NOTICE: Girard Sharp Law Firm Encourages Former Spirit AeroSystems Investors Who Received Shares of The Boeing Company (NYSE: BA) in Connection with The Boeing Company’s Merger with Spirit AeroSystems in December 2025 to Contact the Firm
items.summary: Girard Sharp LLP is investigating potential securities claims on behalf of former Spirit AeroSystems investors who received Boeing shares in the December 2025 merger. Boeing's stock price has declined significantly since the merger closed, with the company reporting substantial losses. The law firm is seeking affected investors for a potential class action lawsuit.

items.title: The Pentagon Is Now the eVTOL Industry's Biggest Customer. Here's How Much Revenue That's Actually Worth to Archer and Joby.
items.summary: Joby Aviation and Archer Aviation are turning to Pentagon defense contracts as a critical revenue bridge while awaiting FAA certification and commercial eVTOL service launches. Joby has a $163 million Air Force contract and acquired Resonant Sciences for $500 million for defense operations, while Archer has a $142 million Air Force contract. Defense revenue provides early, reliable cash flow as both companies face years of cash outflows before commercial viability, though commercial adoption faces headwinds including congested airspace concerns.

items.title: 5 Stocks Poised to Win Big as SpaceX Ramps Up AI Infrastructure
items.summary: SpaceX plans to increase AI computing capacity by 10-20 gigawatts next year, positioning several semiconductor and infrastructure companies as major beneficiaries. Nvidia will be the primary winner as SpaceX's exclusive chip supplier, while SK Hynix, Amphenol, Vertiv, and TSMC are also expected to see significant revenue boosts from increased demand for memory, interconnects, cooling systems, and advanced logic chips.

items.title: 4 Reasons American Express Stock Is Having Its Worst Year Since 2015 Despite Record Earnings
items.summary: American Express stock is down 15.3% year-to-date despite posting record earnings and raising full-year guidance, marking its worst year since 2015. The decline is attributed to valuation pullback after a decade-long surge, declining gross margins due to increased customer reward expenses, concerns about consumer spending weakness amid economic headwinds, and uncertainty around AI investment costs. However, the stock trades at a cheap 17.8x earnings multiple, presenting a potential buying opportunity for long-term investors given the company's strong fundamentals and unique positioning in agentic commerce.

items.title: 11:11 Systems hoogtepunten Eén visie, meer controle: de strategische waarde van een geïntegreerd IT-bedrijfsmodel
items.summary: 11:11 Systems highlights the strategic benefits of an integrated IT operational model for managing complex technology environments, reducing vendor complexity, and improving decision-making. items.summary: Palantir Technologies has earned a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating due to its FedRAMP High accreditation, strong government demand, low capital expenditure model, and consistent earnings beat record. items.title: Illinois Tool Works: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Illinois Tool Works reported Q3 2026 organic revenue growth of nearly 4% with operating margins reaching 27.8%. The company's electronics segment surged 31% driven by semiconductor demand, while customer-backed innovation now contributes over 3% to annual sales growth. Management raised full-year earnings guidance and reaffirmed long-term targets of 4%+ organic growth and 30% operating margins by 2030.

items.title: PayPal: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: PayPal raised its full-year transaction margin dollar guidance to $15.7 billion, driven by cost discipline and expansion into higher-margin financial services. The company is leveraging cost reductions to self-fund growth investments, while Venmo continues strong double-digit growth with significant monetization potential through debit cards and payment integrations. Management projects sustainable mid-single-digit transaction margin dollar growth going forward.

items.title: Sherwin-Williams: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Sherwin-Williams reported 8% consolidated sales growth in Q3 2026 despite soft demand. The company implemented an 8% price increase in its Paint Stores Group and expects $75 million in structural cost savings in 2027. Despite declining single-family home completions, Sherwin-Williams continues gaining market share through its proprietary store network and pricing discipline, positioning itself to protect earnings through the industry downturn.

items.title: Ecolab: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: Ecolab reported strong Q3 2026 results with 7% organic sales growth and 11% organic operating income growth. The company is successfully pivoting toward high-margin segments: Global High-Tech surged 63% driven by AI and data center cooling demand, Life Sciences grew 17% with plans to reach 30% operating margins, while traditional institutional cleaning faced headwinds from declining restaurant foot traffic. Management expects organic sales growth at the upper end of its 5-7% target range and aims to achieve a 20% adjusted operating income margin.

items.title: Here's How Many Shares of Procter & Gamble It Would Take to Fund an Annual $3,000 Vacation From Dividends
items.summary: To fund a $3,000 annual vacation using Procter & Gamble dividends, an investor would need approximately 690 shares, requiring an upfront investment of roughly $110,000. P&G's strong quarterly performance showed 4% organic sales growth, and the company has maintained 136 consecutive years of dividend payments with 70 consecutive years of dividend increases, making it a reliable choice for income-focused investors.

items.title: Essex Property Trust (ESS) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: Essex Property Trust reported Q3 2026 revenue of $492.69 million, slightly missing the consensus estimate of $493.5 million by 0.16%. EPS of $4.00 exceeded expectations of $4.01 by a narrow margin. Key metrics showed occupancy at 96.3% and same-property revenues grew 9% year-over-year. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and has returned 0.8% over the past month.

Despite strong Q3 results with 26% revenue growth, Meta's stock fell 1.65% as investors weighed heavy capital expenditures against future returns.

items.title: Compared to Estimates, Waste Management (WM) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Key Metrics
items.summary: Waste Management reported Q3 2026 revenue of $6.85 billion, up 6.3% year-over-year, slightly beating the consensus estimate of $6.8 billion. However, EPS of $2.15 missed expectations of $2.18. Key metrics showed strong performance across internal revenue growth, renewable energy, recycling, and healthcare solutions segments. The stock has outperformed the broader market with a +16.8% return over the past month but carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

items.title: BellRing Brands Announces Timing of Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
items.summary: BellRing Brands announced it will release its Q4 and fiscal year 2026 financial results on November 18, 2026, followed by a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET. CEO Michael C. Axelrod and CFO Paul A. Rode will discuss results and the fiscal year 2027 outlook.

items.title: Advance Auto Parts vs. Booking Holdings: Flat Against Volatile Revenue
items.summary: Booking Holdings demonstrates strong upward revenue momentum with seasonal peaks reaching $9 billion, while Advance Auto Parts remains flat near $2 billion. Booking is successfully transitioning to a merchant model with improving margins and strong financial health ($16 billion cash, $20 billion buyback program). Advance Auto Parts is executing a turnaround strategy with mixed results, facing headwinds from weak DIY demand, vehicle electrification, and consumer pressures.

items.title: Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Robinhood Markets reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.60 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.56, but revenues of $1.42 billion missed expectations by 1.17%. Despite underperforming the S&P 500 by 17.9% year-to-date, the stock holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating based on favorable estimate revisions. Raymond James Financial is expected to report results on October 28 with projected earnings of $3.28 per share.

items.title: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) Q3 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: Arch Capital Group reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.67 per share, beating consensus estimates by 24.19%, though revenues slightly missed expectations. The company has outperformed consensus EPS estimates in all four recent quarters and holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating. Meanwhile, mortgage insurer NMI Holdings is expected to report results on November 5 with projected earnings of $1.32 per share, representing 9.1% year-over-year growth.

items.title: Why Royal Caribbean Stock Climbed Today
items.summary: Royal Caribbean's stock rallied 5.46% after reporting Q3 2026 results that exceeded expectations, with revenue up 9% to $5.6 billion and adjusted net income jumping 12% to $1.8 billion ($6.57 per share vs. expected $6.38). The company raised its full-year earnings guidance and announced a 50% acquisition of Sandals and Beaches Resorts to expand its market reach. CEO Jason Liberty highlighted strong 2027 booking demand pacing ahead of historical levels.

items.title: PayPal Just Raised Its Profit Forecast, and the Stock Barely Moved. Here’s Why
items.summary: PayPal beat earnings estimates and raised full-year profit guidance, but the stock barely moved due to weak revenue growth and stagnant branded checkout performance. While newer segments like Venmo and BNPL show strong growth, the company's earnings growth is primarily driven by cost-cutting and stock buybacks rather than core business expansion, leaving investors unconvinced about sustainable growth.

items.title: Prediction: This Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock Will Go Parabolic on Oct. 30
items.summary: Micron Technology is positioned to rally following Alphabet and Amazon's earnings reports on Oct. 28-29, as investors expect commentary on memory chip shortages and rising costs. The article argues that memory (DRAM and HBM) is becoming as critical as GPUs for AI infrastructure, with major hyperscalers already citing memory costs as drivers of increased capex budgets. If tech leaders emphasize memory constraints during earnings, Micron's growth prospects could be viewed as more durable, potentially catalyzing a stock rally.

items.title: Ecolab Q3 Earnings In-Line With Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: Ecolab Inc. (ECL) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $2.18, meeting estimates, with revenues rising 13% to $4.69 billion. The company raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $8.10-$8.20, driven by strong organic sales growth of 7%, robust demand in Global High-Tech and data centers, and successful acquisitions. However, the stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: Ralph Lauren's Digital Ecosystem Grows Mid-Teens in All Regions
items.summary: Ralph Lauren Corporation reported mid-teens growth in digital ecosystem sales globally in Q1 fiscal 2027, with Asia revenue rising 25% and China sales surging over 40%. The company expanded its mobile app into Korea and is investing in AI and large language models to enhance digital commerce experiences and consumer engagement.

items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AppLovin Corporation Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AppLovin Corporation alleging that the company made false and misleading statements regarding its generative AI video creative feature, overstated AI model improvements, and misrepresented the benefits of its 'virtuous cycle' value proposition during the period of February 12, 2026 to August 5, 2026. Investors who purchased AppLovin securities during this period are encouraged to join the case.

items.title: PayPal's Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Venmo Growth, TPV Rises
items.summary: PayPal reported Q3 2026 non-GAAP EPS of $1.45, beating estimates by 10.7%, with revenues of $8.58 billion up 2% year-over-year. Venmo TPV grew 14% to $96.81 billion, contributing 20% of total payment volume. The company raised its 2026 EPS outlook to $5.60 and transaction margin forecast to $15.7 billion, driven by strength in Venmo, Braintree, and financial services expansion.

items.title: Verizon Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Growth and AI Expansion
items.summary: Verizon raised its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.04-$5.06 with improved postpaid phone net additions of 1.1M-1.2M. The company added 406,000 postpaid phone subscribers as promotional costs fell 41% and adjusted EBITDA rose 8%. Verizon secured approximately $4 billion in AI infrastructure contracts and plans to expand gigabit coverage to 50M-65M premises, positioning these initiatives as key growth drivers.

items.title: Alexandria's Q3 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Strong Leasing
items.summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities (ARE) reported Q3 2026 adjusted FFO of $1.54 per share, beating estimates, with revenues of $671.2M exceeding forecasts. Leasing volume surged 19% sequentially to 1.24M RSF, the highest since Q4 2024. However, FFO declined 30.6% year-over-year, occupancy improved marginally to 87.1%, and rental rates remained under pressure with a 2.4% decline. The company narrowed its 2026 FFO guidance to $6.38-$6.42 per share while maintaining significant liquidity of $4.56 billion.

items.title: WELL's Q3 FFO Beat Estimates on Strong SHO Portfolio Growth
items.summary: Welltower Inc. (WELL) delivered robust third-quarter results with normalized FFO of $1.67 per share (up 24.6% YoY) and revenues of $3.72 billion (up 38.4% YoY), beating consensus estimates. The company's seniors housing portfolio showed strong momentum with 21% SSNOI growth and occupancy improving 320 basis points to 90.2%. Management raised 2026 FFO guidance to $6.47-$6.53 per share, driven by strong SHO performance and $4.1 billion in investments completed during the quarter.

items.title: ITW Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Electronics Strength
items.summary: Illinois Tool Works (ITW) reported Q3 2026 EPS of $3.00, beating estimates, with revenues of $4.24 billion growing 4.4% year-over-year. Test & Measurement and Electronics surged 17.3%, while operating margin expanded 40 basis points. ITW raised full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $11.45-$11.55 and expects 4.5-5.5% revenue growth. Peer companies Graco missed estimates, while Dover and Allegion both beat expectations with strong organic growth.

items.title: PATH or APP: Which AI-driven Tech Stock Should You Bet on?
items.summary: UiPath and AppLovin are compared as AI-driven investment opportunities. UiPath shows strong fundamentals with 13% revenue growth, 22% operating margins, and four consecutive quarters of GAAP profitability, supported by expanding enterprise adoption of its Maestro automation platform. AppLovin achieved 53% revenue growth but faces concerns as ad installations declined 2%, raising sustainability questions. UiPath is rated as the more attractive investment due to better valuation multiples (3.67X vs 8.93X forward sales) and lower execution risks.

items.title: Can Natural Colors Become Archer Daniels' Next Major Growth Driver?
items.summary: Archer Daniels Midland (ADM) is capitalizing on the shift toward natural food colorants, targeting a $1 billion U.S. market with potential $80-100 million in operating profit gains. The company has secured two new contracts and is investing in Kentucky facilities to expand production. items.summary: S&P Global (SPGI) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $4.58 per share, up 9% year-over-year, beating consensus estimates. items.summary: Waters Corporation announced a partnership with Labcorp Holdings to expand access to the FDA-approved BD Onclarity HPV Assay through Labcorp's network of 850,000+ providers and 2,200 patient service centers beginning in late 2026. The collaboration aims to broaden cervical cancer screening options through flexible delivery methods including clinician-collected, self-collected, and at-home testing. The global HPV testing market is projected to reach $2.2 billion by 2026 with a 14.4% CAGR through 2033.

items.title: Cadence Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on AI Demand, Outlook Raised
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) delivered strong Q3 2026 results with EPS of $2.11 beating estimates by 3.4% and revenues jumping 22% year-over-year to $1.633 billion. AI-driven demand lifted core EDA revenues 20%, semiconductor IP 24%, and System Design 30%. The company raised its 2026 revenue outlook to $6.387-$6.417 billion and EPS guidance to $8.37-$8.43, supported by record backlog of $8.2 billion and accelerating AI adoption.

items.title: Here's Why a Hold Strategy Is Apt for Halliburton Stock for Now
items.summary: Halliburton (HAL) has gained 25.4% YTD, driven by strong Q3 results and international expansion with 9% revenue growth. The company targets 200 basis points of margin expansion in 2027 through restructuring and cost savings. However, weak North American fracturing, declining Completion and Production segment performance, and projected 2026 EPS decline present near-term headwinds. The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

items.title: HIG Q3 Earnings Beat on Investment Income and Premium Growth
items.summary: The Hartford Insurance Group (HIG) reported Q3 2026 core EPS of $3.50, beating estimates by 11.1%, with revenues rising 5.3% to $5.4 billion. Net investment income climbed 12.6% year-over-year, and the company returned $638 million to shareholders while raising its quarterly dividend 12% to 67 cents per share. However, higher catastrophe losses and weaker Employee Benefits profitability partially offset gains.

items.title: McDonald's vs. Chipotle: Which Restaurant Stock Is the Better Buy Now?
items.summary: McDonald's faces persistent traffic challenges and downward earnings revisions despite its strong brand and franchise model, earning a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell). items.summary: Visa (V) is highlighted as a strong momentum pick with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating and Momentum Style Score of A. items.title: Rambus Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Supply Pressures
items.summary: Rambus (RMBS) reported Q3 adjusted earnings of $0.84 per share and revenues of $218.29 million, both exceeding consensus estimates. items.summary: Chinese EV maker Nio delivered over 300,000 vehicles through September, representing a 49.2% year-over-year increase. Additionally, Nio's 'other sales' gross margins turned positive at 6.6% in 2025, driven by improved profitability of its battery-swap network.

items.title: Rambus: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors

Management emphasized continued capital allocation with 40-50% of free cash flows returning to shareholders.

items.title: CME vs. Mastercard: Which Financial Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: CME Group and Mastercard are compared as investment options for 2026. CME dominates derivatives trading with a 62% net margin, lower valuation (P/E 25.3x), and minimal debt (0.1x debt-to-equity), but faces volatile growth averaging 9.5%. Mastercard powers global payments with consistent 14.3% revenue growth, strong free cash flow of $16.4B, but trades at a higher valuation (P/E 33.8x) with 2.5x debt-to-equity. The article suggests CME may appeal to value-focused investors, while Mastercard attracts growth-oriented ones.

items.title: 3 Tech Dividend Stocks That Offer Income and Stock Price Growth Through AI
items.summary: The article highlights three technology dividend stocks that combine income generation with AI-driven growth potential. IBM offers a 2.7% yield with 31 years of consecutive dividend increases, supported by its cloud and AI platforms. Digital Realty Trust, a data center REIT, yields 2.9% and benefits from surging AI infrastructure demand. Cisco Systems yields 1.6% and has recovered strongly due to increased demand for networking and data center equipment driven by the AI boom.

items.title: FedEx Gears Up for Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
items.summary: FedEx is set to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 28 with consensus EPS estimates cut 30.6% to $3.24. However, Network 2.0 savings and healthy pricing may provide some offset.

items.title: PNR Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Dip Y/Y on Pool Weakness
items.summary: Pentair reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $1.18, beating estimates by 10.28%, though earnings declined 4.8% year-over-year. items.title: PFG Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates on Lower Investment Income
items.summary: Principal Financial Group (PFG) reported Q3 2026 operating earnings of $2.22 per share, missing consensus estimates by 9.8%, though revenues grew 9.7% to $4.3 billion. items.title: Does Azure AI Growth Make Microsoft Stock a Hold Ahead of Q1 Earnings?
items.summary: Microsoft's Q1 fiscal 2027 results are expected to be driven by accelerating Azure growth to 45% amid strong AI demand. While AI monetization signals are positive with Foundry revenues doubling and Copilot seats exceeding 30M, elevated capital expenditure exceeding $50 billion, rising component costs, and capacity constraints raise concerns about margin durability. Microsoft maintains a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

items.summary: Brown & Brown (BRO) reported Q3 2026 revenues of $1.72B, up 7.4% YoY but missing consensus by 2.3%, with organic growth slowing to just 1.2%. The company raised Accession synergy targets to $175M by 2028 and repurchased $250M in shares, but margin pressure and weakness in Specialty Distribution weighed on performance.

items.title: Truist Financial Explores AFCO Credit Sale to Sharpen Strategic Focus

This follows the bank's $5.5 billion near-prime auto loan exit and planned $7.7 billion LightStream divestiture to Carlyle Group. The moves aim to improve funding efficiency and profitability, though sale terms remain uncertain.

items.title: INV DEADLINE ALERT: Hagens Berman Alerts Innventure, Inc. Investors to Today’s Lead Plaintiff Deadline in Securities Class Action
items.summary: Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV) faces a securities class action lawsuit after its stock plummeted 55-74% in August 2026. items.title: Fast Simon Unveils Commerce-Native AI to Help Brands Grow Revenue by Optimizing Product Discovery
items.summary: Fast Simon launched its Commerce-Native AI model, a purpose-built platform that combines shopper intent, brand strategy, and business priorities to optimize product discovery and drive revenue growth. The model empowers merchandisers with control over brand strategy while continuously optimizing product rankings and recommendations. Available immediately, it supports both returning and first-time visitors on Shopify.

items.title: AMT Q3 AFFO & Revenues Rise on Steady Demand, 2026 Outlook Raised
items.summary: American Tower (AMT) beat Q3 earnings expectations with AFFO per share of $2.87 vs. consensus of $2.84, driven by strong 17.4% data center revenue growth. items.title: Invesco Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates Despite Y/Y Revenue & AUM Growth
items.summary: Invesco reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of 72 cents per share, missing the consensus estimate of 75 cents, though earnings rose 18% year-over-year. items.title: IQVIA Holdings Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Increase 8% Y/Y
items.summary: IQVIA Holdings reported strong Q3 2026 results with adjusted EPS of $3.34 (up 11.3% YoY) and revenues of $4.43B (up 8% YoY), both beating consensus estimates. However, operating costs remain elevated and the stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

items.title: CMS Energy Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: CMS Energy Corporation reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of $1.44, beating consensus estimates by 7.5% with a 54.8% year-over-year increase. However, operating expenses surged 38.7%, causing operating income to decline significantly. The company reaffirmed its 2026 EPS guidance of $3.83-$3.90 and 2027 guidance of $4.08-$4.17, maintaining its long-term 6-8% EPS growth outlook.

items.title: CenterPoint Energy Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Improve Y/Y
items.summary: CenterPoint Energy (CNP) reported Q3 2026 adjusted EPS of 53 cents, beating estimates by 6%, with revenues rising 10.2% to $2.19B. items.title: Cadence Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Expansion and Higher Outlook
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) raised its 2026 revenue guidance to $6.387-$6.417 billion and non-GAAP EPS to $8.37-$8.43, driven by accelerating AI adoption, over 100 AI Super Agent customer engagements, and a record $8.2 billion backlog. Core EDA revenues grew 20% year-over-year with recurring revenues up 18%, while the company's Maestro AI models demonstrated 30% higher quality than general-purpose models.

items.title: TSM Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Strong AI Demand and Expansion
items.summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) reported Q3 2026 revenues of $46.72B, up 41.2% year-over-year, exceeding expectations. items.title: Airbnb vs. Five Below: Which Consumer Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
items.summary: Airbnb and Five Below represent two distinct consumer growth plays with different strengths. Airbnb leads in growth (24.2% avg YoY since 2021) and profitability (19.4% operating margin), while Five Below offers better valuation multiples (P/E 22.0x vs 33.1x) and impressive 22.9% FY2025 revenue growth. items.summary: Palantir Technologies and RTX Corporation offer two distinct approaches to defense investing through 2030. Palantir, an AI software company serving defense and intelligence agencies, posted 93% revenue growth but trades at a premium P/E of 168. RTX, a diversified defense contractor with established products and a $340 billion backlog, offers more balanced valuation at P/E of 31 with dividend support. Palantir suits growth-oriented investors, while RTX appeals to those seeking stability and diversification.

items.title: Fortrea to Participate in Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
items.summary: Fortrea (FTRE), a leading global CRO, announced that CEO Anshul Thakral, CFO Jason Knoblauch, and SVP of Investor Relations Tracy Krumme will participate in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London on November 17, 2026, with a fireside chat and 1x1 meetings scheduled.

items.title: Wall Street Has a New Blockbuster Stock Split Coming in 2027 -- It's an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock That's Up 1,615% in 14 Years
items.summary: Meta Platforms announced a 2-for-1 stock split scheduled for January 19, 2027, creating a new Class C non-voting stock. The move aims to maintain Mark Zuckerberg's voting control above 60% while enabling the company to raise capital for its massive AI infrastructure investments without diluting his power. Meta plans to spend $135-145 billion on AI capex this year and expects to need hundreds of billions more.

items.title: I Asked Anthropic's Own AI Model Whether I Should Buy the IPO. Claude's Answer Shocked Me.
items.summary: Anthropic filed its S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT. The company generated $16.3B in revenue in H1 2026 with 1,300% YoY growth, but reported an $80.7B net loss (mostly non-cash charges). Claude AI identified concerns including long-term compute commitments through 2045, competition from cloud partners, and founder voting control. Claude recommended caution at higher valuations, suggesting only a small speculative position at $500B valuation (15x P/S), but passing at $1T (31x P/S) or $2T (61x P/S).

items.title: Hilton Worldwide Holdings Inc. (HLT) Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Hilton Worldwide Holdings (HLT) reported Q3 2026 earnings of $2.45 per share, beating consensus estimates of $2.36, but revenues of $3.33 billion missed expectations by 1.93%. The stock has gained 22.5% year-to-date, outperforming the S&P 500's 12.1% gain. However, the company received a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed estimate revisions, and the Hotels and Motels industry ranks in the bottom 36% of Zacks industries.

items.title: Webull Might Be the Most Undervalued Fintech Stock
items.summary: Webull (BULL) is positioned as an undervalued fintech alternative to Robinhood, growing faster in revenue (51% YoY) and users (13% YoY) while trading at a lower valuation (P/E under 15 vs. Robinhood's 34). The company is expanding its AI capabilities, seeing strong growth in prediction markets (71% sequential growth), and improving profitability with widening margins. Webull is also committing to $100 million in share buybacks over the next 12 months.

items.title: Amazon Is Underperforming the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100. Could Oct. 29 Mark a Turning Point?
items.summary: Amazon's stock has risen only 7% in 2026, underperforming the S&P 500 (11%) and Nasdaq-100 (16%), despite strong business fundamentals. The company's low-margin e-commerce business and massive capital expenditures ($220 billion annually) have pressured valuations. Ahead of Q3 earnings on Oct. 29, the article suggests long-term investors should focus on Amazon's strong AWS growth and digital advertising expansion rather than short-term catalysts, as current investments in AI infrastructure should drive future profitability.

items.title: Broadcom vs. Taiwan Semiconductor: Two AI Powerhouses, One Surprising Revenue Trend
items.summary: Both Broadcom and Taiwan Semiconductor are capitalizing on the AI infrastructure boom, but with notably different growth trajectories. Taiwan Semiconductor remains the larger business with quarterly revenue reaching $46.7 billion (41% YoY growth), while Broadcom has demonstrated more impressive acceleration, more than doubling quarterly revenue from $14.9 billion to $29.6 billion (86% YoY growth). Broadcom's faster growth is driven by demand for custom AI processors and networking equipment, while Taiwan Semiconductor benefits from broad-based demand for advanced chip manufacturing across multiple customers.
